newsitem.title: FINLAND: POLL - FISKARS JAN-JUNE RESULT SEEN HIGHER.
newsitem.headline: POLL - FISKARS JAN-JUNE RESULT SEEN HIGHER.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts
covering Finnish equities showed a 166.5 million markka median
forecast for durable consumer goods group Fiskars' first half
profit after financial items, before extraordinary items.
Profit after financial items
(FIM million)
Median 166.5
Mean 174.4
Lowest 157.0
Highest 204.0
(Profit forecast by eight analysts)
The results are due on August 18 at 0900/0600 GMT.
In January-June 1996, Fiskars posted a 139 million markka
profit before extraordinaries. In the first quarter this year,
Fiskars had a 59 million markka profit.
Fiskars has not given any forecasts for earnings this year.
The median of forecasts for Fiskars' full-year 1997 earnings
was for a 283 million markka profit before extraordinaries (mean
286 million) and the range was 263-315 million markka. Fiskars'
1996 profit before extraordinaries was 215 million markka.
Contributors to the survey were: AG Private Bankers, Alfred
Berg, Aros Securities, Carnegie Securities, FIM Securities, Evli
Securities, Merita and Opstock.
